role_summary: FinOps Engineer role connecting Engineering, Finance and Product teams to improve AWS and Azure cloud economics, cost visibility and financial governance.
responsibility_text: Multi-cloud cost visibility; AI token cost management; cost allocation and tagging; Savings Plans and Reserved Instances; waste elimination; weekly and monthly forecasting; anomaly detection; investment advisory. Partner with Finance, Engineering, Product and DevOps stakeholders.
requirement_text: AWS CUR, Azure Billing APIs, SQL, Python, Power BI or Tableau; AWS and Azure pricing models; technical architecture translated into financial impact; financial modelling and business cases.
preferred_text: FinOps Certified Practitioner or FinOps Certified Engineer; AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner; Microsoft Azure Fundamentals AZ-900.
